item.title: Vinchin Backup & Recovery V9.0 SP3: Overview and Hands-On with Proxmox VE
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: Breaking down Vinchin Backup & Recovery V9.0 SP3 - platform-agnostic backup and migration for mixed and import-independent infrastructure: architecture, bare-metal install, Proxmox VE support and Russian virtualization platforms (zVirt, RED, ROSA, HOSTVM), plus a detailed comparison with Proxmox Backup Server.
